label: Morocco Atlas + Sahara
summary: 7 nights: Marrakech, High Atlas, Erg Chebbi dunes (Christmas Eve camp), Middle Atlas cedars for Barbary macaques. Out CMN via Cairo; land NBO ~04:55 Dec 28.
verdict: Big culture/scenery change before Kenya; wildlife thin beyond macaques, camels, birds. Costs: long Dec 27 via Cairo (verify MS849 23:55 not 20:55), freezing desert nights, ~+$1,995 pp.

safety.advisory_level: US State Dept Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution (terrorism). Advisory reissued Sep 4 2026, level unchanged.
safety.summary: Stable, tourist-friendly; Level 2 for general terrorism (tourist sites, transport, markets; last deadly attacks 2011 Marrakech, 2018 Imlil). Daily risks: petty theft, medina hustlers, winter mountain roads. Merzouga near closed Algerian border, but dune zone safe.
precautions: Licensed driver, daylight only; Tizi n'Tichka (2,260 m), Midelt road may ice. Check night before.
Medina: ignore faux guides; agree henna/photo prices first; watch pickpockets.
Stay in Erg Chebbi tourist zone, not east toward Algeria; stick with camp guide at night.
Bottled/filtered water, few raw salads early; carry rehydration salts.
Desert and Azrou below 0 C at night: warm layer, hat, sleeping-bag liner.
Women may get medina catcalls; modest dress, firm 'la, shukran'.
Stay airside in Cairo; one ticket for whole routing. EgyptAir ~50-60% on time.
Enroll STEP; carry passport copy for rural police checkpoints.

visa: US: Morocco visa-free 90 days (passport 6+ months, 1 blank page). CDG airside transit: no visa, no EES/ETIAS. Cairo airside: no visa. Kenya eTA must cover Dec 28 entry.
weather_dec: Dry, sunny. Marrakech 18-20 C / 5-7 C. Ouarzazate/Dades 16-18 C / 0-3 C. Merzouga 17-20 C / 1-5 C (heavy blankets). Azrou/Ifrane (1,250-1,650 m) ~10 C, nights below freezing, snow possible. Tichka may close briefly after snow. Sunset ~17:45.
highlights: Christmas Eve Erg Chebbi camp: sunset camels, stars, Berber drums, sunrise on 150 m dunes
Barbary macaques, Cedre Gouraud forest near Azrou (Africa's only macaque, endangered)
High Atlas via Tizi n'Tichka to UNESCO ksar Ait Benhaddou
Todra Gorge (300 m walls), Dades 'road of a thousand kasbahs'
Marrakech medina, Jemaa el-Fna night market, Majorelle + Berber Museum
Merzouga/Dayet Srji birding: desert sparrow, fulvous babbler, flamingos if wet
Khamlia Gnawa music on Christmas Day
drawbacks: Wildlife weak vs Kenya: macaques only real mammal; fennec, Barbary sheep rare
No Morocco-NBO nonstop. MS848 CMN 13:30-CAI 20:25, then MS849; only 23:55 slot connects (20:55 seen in 2026). Verify
Dec 26 (~5h road) + Dec 27 (~3.5h road + ~13h flights/layover) back to back; Dec 28 rest absorbs
Dec 19 is Sat; AT251 LAX-CMN (10:20) flies Sun/Tue/Fri only, so connect via Europe or leave Fri Dec 18. Turkish forces Istanbul overnight
Cold desert/Middle Atlas nights; budget riads, auberges poorly heated
Peak European holiday season: book camps, riads now
Upgrade: luxury camp ($180-350 pp/night) + private 4x4 guide, ~+$400-700 pp
Cheaper: shared 3-day Marrakech-Merzouga-Fes tours (~$190-300 pp), but 9-10h drives break pace rule

legs.detail: Overnight, e.g. Air France/Delta afternoon dep, arr ~10:00-11:30 Dec 20. Alts: Iberia via MAD, Star Alliance via FRA/MUC. AT251 nonstop not Sat (Sun/Tue/Fri).
Air France/Transavia/RAM, ~2-3h connection; arr RAK late afternoon. ~25 min taxi/riad pickup to medina (~150-200 MAD).
Private driver via Tizi n'Tichka (2,260 m), ~190 km. Argan co-op, viewpoints; optional Telouet lunch.
Ouarzazate, Skoura palmery, Dades Gorge switchbacks, Todra. ~280 km, many stops.
Tinghir-Alnif-Rissani-Merzouga, ~200 km. Leave luggage at auberge; small overnight bag.
Sunset camel (or 4x4) into Erg Chebbi to camp.
Camel/4x4 back after dune sunrise; easy day in Merzouga.
Erfoud-Errachidia-Ziz Gorges-Midelt-Azrou, ~370 km. Break Errachidia, lunch Midelt; Cedre Gouraud ~15:00 for macaques. Longest drive, at 5h limit.
Leave ~07:30 via Meknes, A2/A1 toll motorways, ~300 km; arr CMN ~11:00 for 13:30. Backup: Fes airport (1h15) + RAM domestic to CMN.
EgyptAir MS848 CMN 13:30 (T2)-CAI 20:25 (T3), A321neo, daily per 2026 data. ~3.5h airside.

MS849 CAI 23:55 Dec 27-NBO 04:55 Dec 28 (737-800). Some 2026 dates 20:55 (no connect); verify. Backups: QR1396 CMN 20:50 Dec 26-DOH 06:00, QR1341 DOH 18:45-NBO 23:50 Dec 27 (drops Azrou). Or TK618 CMN Dec 26-IST overnight, TK607 IST 18:45 Dec 27-NBO 01:25 Dec 28.

itinerary.title: Depart LAX
itinerary.details: Afternoon LAX-CDG (~10.5h, overnight). Sleep on plane.

itinerary.title: Arrive Marrakech
itinerary.details: Land CDG ~10-11:30, connect to RAK (~3.5h), arr late afternoon. Riad pickup ~25 min. Mint tea, early night. ~6h travel + yesterday's 10.5h.

itinerary.title: Rest + medina
itinerary.details: No transport. Slow morning. Majorelle + Berber Museum, souks, Ben Youssef Medersa. Sunset terrace over Jemaa el-Fna, night food stalls. Driver briefing.

itinerary.title: Over the Atlas
itinerary.details: Driver 08:30. Tizi n'Tichka, ~4h with stops. Afternoon Ait Benhaddou ksar walk, granary at sunset. Moussier's redstart on pass.
itinerary.meals: B, L roadside tagine, D guesthouse (half board)

itinerary.title: Kasbah valley
itinerary.details: ~4h: Ouarzazate, Skoura, Dades switchbacks, Todra. Late-afternoon gorge walk (300 m walls).

itinerary.title: Christmas Eve, dunes
itinerary.details: Morning gorge walk, ~3h road to Merzouga. ~15:30 camel 1-1.5h to camp; sunset, dinner, drums, stars. Cold (1-5 C).

itinerary.title: Christmas rest
itinerary.details: Dune sunrise, camel back ~1h, breakfast + shower at auberge. Lazy. Optional: Khamlia Gnawa, Dayet Srji birding, nap.

itinerary.title: Cedars + macaques
itinerary.details: Dep 08:00. ~5h: Ziz Gorges, Midelt lunch, Azrou. ~15:00 Cedre Gouraud macaques; Levaillant's woodpecker possible. Snow possible.

itinerary.title: Long haul to Kenya
itinerary.details: Leave 07:30, ~3.5h (~300 km) to CMN. MS848 13:30-CAI 20:25, ~3.5h airside, MS849 23:55-NBO 04:55 Dec 28. Then Nairobi rest day.

lodging.name: Riad Dar Najat (or similar budget medina riad)
lodging.why: Walk to square, souks; quiet courtyard for jet lag
lodging.alternatives: Riad Laaroussa/Yasmine (~$90-150 pp); Equity Point hostel (~$20 pp)

lodging.name: Gorge auberge, e.g. Hotel Yasmina or Auberge Le Festival
lodging.location: Inside or near the Todra Gorge
lodging.why: Gorge walks late afternoon, early morning

lodging.name: Standard Erg Chebbi desert camp (private tent with bed)
lodging.location: Erg Chebbi dunes, ~1h camel from Merzouga
lodging.includes: Camel both ways, dinner, breakfast, blankets; bathroom sometimes shared
lodging.why: Christmas Eve highlight; pick en-suite or heated tent

lodging.name: Merzouga auberge, e.g. Kasbah Mohayut or Riad Madu
lodging.location: Merzouga village, at the dune edge
lodging.why: Christmas rest, hot showers; luggage stays here

lodging.name: Azrou/Ifrane hotel, e.g. Hotel Le Panorama Azrou
lodging.location: Azrou town, 15 min from the Cedre Gouraud
lodging.why: Near macaque forest, on motorway route to CMN

budget.item: Multi-city: LAX-RAK Dec 19 via Europe; CMN-CAI-NBO Dec 27 (MS848/MS849); NBO-LAX Jan 16 (TK608/TK9)
budget.notes: Replaces $1,500 base: ~+$900 pp (+$500 to +$1,400). Morocco-NBO one-way ~$630-710; LAX-Morocco ~$800-1,100; NBO-LAX ~$800-1,100. One Star Alliance ticket protects connections. Estimate; no live festive fare, verify.

budget.item: 7 nights: 2 riad, kasbah, auberge, camp, auberge, Azrou hotel (shared doubles)
budget.notes: 70+35+30+75+35+30. Mostly half board. High end: luxury camp, nicer riads.

budget.item: Private driver + car, 6 days Marrakech-CMN one-way + RAK transfer
budget.notes: ~$150-180/day per vehicle incl. fuel, driver lodging, plus one-way surcharge, split 2. Get local quotes; private 4-day Marrakech-Fes tours ~$750-940 pp incl. lodging. Shared ~$190-300 pp, 9-10h days.

budget.item: Majorelle + Berber Museum, Ben Youssef, Ait Benhaddou, gorge guide, Khamlia, tips
budget.notes: Majorelle + Berber Museum ~200 MAD. Driver tip ~$10-15/day per car.
Tagine lunch ~$6-12; half board covers most dinners.

budget.item: Morocco visa-free; Egypt airside no visa

booking.task: Book multi-city (LAX-RAK Dec 19 / CMN-NBO Dec 27 / NBO-LAX Jan 16), one ticket. Confirm Dec MS849 23:55 not 20:55 (MS848 arr 20:25). Compare Qatar/Turkish.
Book Dec 24 Erg Chebbi camp, Marrakech riad: peak season.
Book licensed driver Dec 22-27, one-way to CMN; confirm 07:30 Dec 27 dep, motorway route.
Book Ait Benhaddou, Todra, Merzouga, Azrou (half board).
Insurance with trip-delay cover; check Kenya eTA covers Dec 28.
Reconfirm flights (MS849 shifted often in 2026); pack warm layers.
Brief driver; check Tizi n'Tichka snow for Dec 22.

fatigue: Travel h/day. Dec 19: ~10.5h flight. Dec 20: ~6h (connection, 3.5h flight, transfer). Dec 21: 0. Dec 22: ~4h road. Dec 23: ~4h. Dec 24: ~3h + 1.5h camel. Dec 25: ~1h. Dec 26: ~5h. Dec 27: ~3.5h road + ~5h flight + ~3.5h layover + ~5h overnight flight (NBO 04:55 Dec 28). Dec 28: Nairobi rest. 5h road max met; Dec 26 at limit. Rest days Dec 21, Dec 25. Weak spot: Dec 26-27 back to back into overnight flight. Fix: drop Azrou, fly Errachidia-CMN Dec 26, or overnight Casablanca.
safety_short: Stable, tourist-friendly. Risks: terrorism alert, petty theft, hustlers, winter mountain roads.
